title.zh: House Oversight Chair Comer Probes Delaware Plan for AI-Run Companies
title.en: House Oversight Chair Comer Probes Delaware Plan for AI-Run Companies

current_state.zh: House Oversight Chairman James Comer has opened an investigation into Delaware's plan to allow AI agents to run companies while shielding owners from liability, demanding documents from Gov. Matt Meyer by November 9.
current_state.en: House Oversight Chairman James Comer has opened an investigation into Delaware's plan to allow AI agents to run companies while shielding owners from liability, demanding documents from Gov. Matt Meyer by November 9.
